function: Excluded, no_learning: beamforming and tag reflection are set by alternating optimization with closed-form updates; ML only clusters users with mean shift (p. 4).
notes: Excluded for no_learning (code 3). The physical-layer design, the primary transmitter beamformer and the tag reflection coefficients, is a classical alternating optimization (WMMSE and Dinkelbach), p. 4: "Each variable closed-form solution used in" the EE maximization AO algorithm. The only ML element is a mean shift clustering of the primary receivers, p. 4: "modified mean shift clustering scheme (MSS) ML algorithm", run online with no trained parameters, and it does user grouping, which is not one of the seven areas (p. 2: "We propose an ML-based modified mean shift clustering for the" PR clustering). Benchmarks are ZF and MRT beamformers, not learned (p. 5). If the reviewer counts mean shift as a learned component, the exclusion would be function instead, with the same decision. The PDF is the HAL copy; p. 1 is the HAL cover sheet and gives the DOI 10.1109/LCOMM.2024.3448372, matching the DOI of the list.
